name: mathclass-rules-tests
description: Security-rules tests and an end-to-end smoke test, run against the Firebase emulators.

scripts.e2e: test -f ../functions/.env.local || echo CLAUDE_PROVIDER=fake > ../functions/.env.local; firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-mathclass --config ../firebase.json "node --test e2e.smoke.mjs"
